But quoting a piece of context back into "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"the chat should be one gesture, not a copy-paste chore. **dsh-selection-ask** gives the web GUI a Ch"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"atGPT-style selection helper: select text in a conversation and a floating **「询问 DeepSeek」** button "},{"id":"p5s4","text":"appears beside it. Just type your follow-up and send."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Zero friction quoting** — the exact gesture you know from ChatGPT, in DeepSeek Harness.
- **Offi"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"cial integration, no hacks** — writes through the harness's `inputActions.setDraft` input-machine AP"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"I, so undo history and draft persistence keep working. It never touches DSH internals or DOM state d"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"irectly.
- **One command to install** — the compiled `lib/` is committed, so a `github:` install fet"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ches ready-to-load artifacts with no build step."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Button follows the selection** — positioned at the selection's screen coordinates (`position: fi"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"xed`), clamped to the viewport, hidden once the selection scrolls away.
- **Quotes conversation text"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" only** — selections must be inside the transcript (`[data-conversation-scroll]`); selecting inside "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"the composer itself does nothing (quoting the draft back into itself is nonsense).

A document-level `selectionchange`/`mous"},{"id":"p44s3","text":"eup` listener detects selections inside the transcript and renders a `position: fixed` button at the"},{"id":"p44s4","text":" selection's bounding rect. Clicking builds a Markdown quote, joins it with the current draft, write"},{"id":"p44s5","text":"s the full draft through `inputActions.setDraft` — the input machine's official write path — then fo"},{"id":"p44s6","text":"cuses the composer textarea."}],"truncated":true}
